iterationEvidence.note: Iteration receipts retain their exact input snapshots. Subsequent source or commit changes require fresh final evidence.

coverage.floors: Preserve every historical target, group and file floor.
coverage.reportMeaning: Production, fixture and other target-source counts are supplemental; official gates and ratchet calculations remain unchanged.

performance.method: Five matched sample indices at 1k, 10k and 300k commits, hidden/visible columns and fixed viewport/applied counts. Historical base-all followed by current-all; no alternating or randomized claim. Fixture construction and drawing are excluded. Reset and complete rebinding remain separate; existing ceilings remain unchanged.

deliveryRequiredEvidence.authority: The final workflow receipt must pass at the final commit, including coverage, packages, sanitizers, UI, performance, analysis and Debug app staging. Iteration receipts do not establish delivery readiness.
